# List Item

```tsx
import { ListItem, ListItemContentLeft, ListItemTrendIcon, listItemVariants } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

A row of a list: label and description with optional drag handle, checkbox, icon, details and tag on the left, and text, tag, arrow or buttons on the right. Mirrors the Figma List Item: Type (Discreet / Divider / Container) × State (Default / Pressed / Disabled), with the .List Item Content Left and Content Right partials as props. With `clickable` (the default when `onClick` is set) the whole item is clickable and shows Pressed on hover and press; with `clickable={false}` it has no hover and only the nested Buttons and Checkboxes respond. Stop propagation in nested buttons and checkboxes so they don't also trigger a clickable item.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<StoryListItem {...args} />
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma List Item: Type (Discreet / Divider / Container) × State (Default / Pressed / Disabled) + Focus, with the .List Item Content Left and .List Item Content Right partials as props.
- Pressed is Background/Hover: a fill on Divider, an overlay painted by ::after on top of the surface on Container (like the stacked Figma fills). Figma has no Pressed Discreet. It shows on hover and press, and only when the item is clickable; `data-pressed` forces it.
- The Divider and Container strokes are Inside in Figma: painted by ::before over the content, so they take no room. The ribbon sits flush against the edge under the stroke, and the content starts 16px after the ribbon (or after the edge when the ribbon is hidden).
- Disabled is the whole item at 50% opacity (Container also drops its shadow).
- Focus is the 3px Border/Accent/Strong ring, 2px away from the item, with the Border/Radius/Focus corners on the square types.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`ListItemContentLeftProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Label/Medium in Text/Primary. |
| `description?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Description: Body/Medium in Text/Secondary. |
| `details?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Details: Body/Small in Text/Secondary. |
| `detailsTrend?` | `ListItemTrend` | Figma Show Icon Trend: the trend icon before the details. |
| `tag?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Tag: a Small Accent Strong Tag under the text. |
| `dragHandle?` | `boolean` | Figma Show Drag Handle. |
| `checkbox?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Checkbox: pass a `<Checkbox />`. |
| `icon?` | `IconSvgElement` | Figma Show Icon: a Hugeicons icon in the Icon Colors container. |
| `iconColor?` | `VariantProps<typeof iconColorsVariants>["color"]` | Color of the Icon Colors container (Figma Icon Colors Color). |
| `contentLeft?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Content Left Custom=True: replaces the whole left content. |

`ListItemProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled?` | `boolean` | Figma State=Disabled. |
| `clickable?` | `boolean` | Makes the whole item clickable: `onClick` fires on it, it shows Pressed on hover and press, and it's focusable (a plain item gets `role="button"` and responds to Enter and Space). Defaults to true when `onClick` is set. When false, the item does nothing and has no hover; nested Buttons and Checkboxes stay clickable. |
| `showRibbon?` | `boolean` | Figma Show Ribbon (Type=Container only). |
| `textRight?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Text Right: Body/Medium in Text/Secondary. |
| `textRightTrend?` | `ListItemTrend` | Figma Show Trend Icon: the trend icon before the right text. |
| `tagRight?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Tag (right): a Small Accent Strong Tag. |
| `arrow?` | `boolean` | Figma Show Icon Arrow: the trailing Arrow Right. |
| `actions?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Buttons: 1 to 3 icon-only Ghost Buttons, 12px apart. |
| `contentRight?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Content Right Custom=True: replaces the whole right content. |

## Types

`ListItemProps`, `ListItemContentLeftProps`, `ListItemTrend`

## Rules

- Import `ListItem` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
